tasks.short: Evaluate and treat visual system disorders

steps.what: Evaluate visual system disorders and provide treatment while assessing binocular function and eye movements

tasks.design: Keep visual assessment and treatment with the orthoptist using the orthoptic examination workstation {OTHER}. Existing equipment supports observation, while clinical judgement and hands-on care remain human responsibilities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Eye movement and binocular findings depend on patient participation and clinical context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing examination equipment supports care without replacing professional judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Variable responses and changing symptoms can complicate assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The orthoptist adapts examination and care and recognises the need for escalation.
tasks.altitude: No assumed reduction in clinical evaluation or treatment effort.

reach.learn: Communicate findings, uncertainty and changes requiring specialist review.

evidence.claim: Retaining orthoptic clinical evaluation and treatment is model knowledge; no applicable autonomous capability appears in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is clinical evaluation and delivered care; separate plan development, formal test interpretation and instruction preparation must not be counted again.
OTHER is orthoptic examination workstation. Orthoptist produces clinical findings during s1; no free structured diagnostic or treatment-suitability flag is assumed.
Consider existing native equipment features first. Zero upkeep because no new workflow is introduced. Actual professional scope and national rules remain customer facts.
research_questions: Which uncertain or changing findings require specialist assessment rather than routine continuation?

already_counted.description: All clinical assessment, treatment and checked actions remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Specific patient assessment, selected care and relevant findings; changes require renewed judgement.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. Clinical and physical care remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop nonsurgical treatment plans by weighing clinical findings, patient needs and likely adherence

tasks.design: Retain individual plan development with the orthoptist in the patient record system {OTHER}. Native plan fields support recording, while treatment selection and review conditions require clinical judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Treatment depends on the disorder, patient circumstances and response history.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support planning without establishing a reliable automatic treatment recommendation.
tasks.still_hard: A technically plausible plan may be inappropriate or impractical for the patient.
tasks.human_edge: The orthoptist weighs patient needs and sets conditions for review or escalation.
tasks.altitude: No assumed reduction in treatment planning or change in decision rights.

reach.learn: Explain treatment rationale and the circumstances requiring reassessment.

evidence.claim: Individual orthoptic treatment planning remains clinical judgement, based on model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is plan development, excluding previously counted examination, test interpretation and later instruction delivery.

Earlier clinical assessment produces findings; orthoptist checks them and determines actual treatment, schedule and review conditions during s1. No preselected treatment or adherence classification is assumed.
OTHER means patient record system. Native plan fields precede custom tooling. Zero upkeep because this proposal adds no automation.
research_questions: Which patient circumstances most often require modification of the usual plan?

already_counted.description: All individual planning and plan acceptance remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient plan, clinical basis, schedule and review conditions; changes void acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. No clinical plan development is replaced by a generic template.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain diagnoses and treatment plans to families

steps.what: Select patient instructions and tailor their content to the actual diagnosis, plan and family needs
Assemble instructions with the selected content and clinician-specified treatment details
Check instructions, explain the plan and confirm patient or family understanding

tasks.design: Configure native handout assembly in the patient record system {OTHER} from clinician-selected approved content. Keep individual tailoring, final checking, explanation and understanding assessment with the orthoptist; no generated treatment advice is sent automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated copying and formatting of selected guidance consumed preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can combine explicit plan fields and controlled instruction blocks.
tasks.still_hard: A correct sheet does not establish that the patient can follow the instructions.
tasks.human_edge: The orthoptist adapts explanations and checks understanding through dialogue.
tasks.altitude: Less handout assembly; individual counselling time and treatment authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Use consistent language and identify unresolved understanding barriers.

evidence.claim: Thuisarts provides vetted guideline-based health information; it does not establish coverage for every orthoptic plan or automate personalised instructions.
Native assembly from clinician-selected instruction blocks is model knowledge; the task savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is instructional preparation and delivery, excluding creation of the clinical plan and patient execution at home.

In s1 orthoptist produces patient/plan version, selected content IDs and revisions, exact prescribed schedule, review/contact instructions, language and recipient details. Capture and tailoring remain counted; missing or unsuitable approved content is written manually without machine assembly.
OTHER means patient record system. Native handouts precede custom code; no free comprehension or readiness flag is assumed.
unknowns: Approved content coverage and accessibility needs
research_questions: Does the assembled sheet preserve the exact plan schedule and avoid conflicting instructions while patient understanding remains checked?

already_counted.description: Content tailoring, final checking and all individual explanation.

incremental.description: Maintain clinical instruction blocks and template regression examples.
Record administrator maintains permitted plan-field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact instruction sheet, patient/plan revision and selected blocks; edits require renewed checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=80 gross=20 net=13 after 7 upkeep. Zero if native handouts already cover the task or no assembly occurs; 3 for a modest repeatable handout subset with unchanged counselling.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Interpret clinical or diagnostic results against test reliability, patient context and competing explanations

tasks.design: Keep diagnostic result interpretation with the orthoptist in the orthoptic examination workstation {OTHER}. Existing result displays support comparison, while reliability, clinical meaning and follow-up require professional judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test responses depend on participation, conditions and the broader clinical picture.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing displays support review without establishing a suitable autonomous interpretation tool.
tasks.still_hard: A numerical change may reflect test conditions rather than a clinical change.
tasks.human_edge: The orthoptist identifies unreliable results and chooses appropriate further assessment.
tasks.altitude: No assumed reduction in diagnostic interpretation effort.

reach.learn: Communicate test conditions and uncertainty alongside the result.

evidence.claim: Orthoptic test interpretation remains clinical judgement, based on model knowledge; the digest's mammography example is not applicable evidence.

assumptions: Boundary is test-result interpretation, excluding test execution and subsequent treatment planning already scoped elsewhere.

Test operator produces raw observations and conditions during separately counted testing before this task; orthoptist evaluates reliability in s1. No structured valid-result or diagnosis flag is assumed.
OTHER means orthoptic examination workstation. Consider native result views first. Zero upkeep because no new workflow is proposed.
unknowns: Existing test systems and reliability indicators
research_questions: Which observed changes remain after accounting for test reliability and examination conditions?

already_counted.description: All test reliability and clinical interpretation remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. Clinical interpretation remains fully human; existing instrument runtime creates no labour saving.

role.altitude: Repeated instruction-sheet assembly may shrink preparation while evaluation, treatment planning and result interpretation remain clinical work.
reach: Coordinate complex findings with ophthalmologists and consistent instruction support with ophthalmic nurses.
role.ambitious_version: An orthoptist whose patient materials match the exact plan and whose clinical decisions remain grounded in reliable observations.
